meanings: surname Guo, country; nation; state, (bound form) national
surname Guo, to cross, to go over, to pass (time), to celebrate (a holiday), to live, to get along, excessively, too-, (experienced action marker)
surname Huan, still, still in progress, still more, yet, even more, in addition, fairly, passably (good), as early as, even, also, else, to pay back, to return
still (as before), had better, unexpectedly, or
